description: B-0 (epic #1357): daily analytics history (GA4 / GSC) as append-only JSONL. Written by scripts/append_analytics_history.py from 18-analytics-daily.yml cron.

gsc_by_query.jsonl.description: GSC Search Analytics by_query, 1 line per (date, query)

gsc_by_page.jsonl.description: GSC Search Analytics by_page, 1 line per (date, page)

gsc_totals.jsonl.description: GSC site totals, 1 line per date

ga4_pages.jsonl.description: GA4 by hostName x pagePath, 1 line per (date, hostName, pagePath)

ga4_totals.jsonl.description: GA4 site totals, 1 line per date

idempotency.note: append_analytics_history.py marks (source, date) here. Re-running with the same date is a no-op.

retention.rationale: GSC Search Analytics API only returns ~16 months of history (hard limit). Keep 18 months locally as a safety margin.

estimated_volume.format: UTF-8 JSONL, one JSON object per line, sort_keys=True

consumers_future: trend analysis for A-1/A-2 detection (compare current week vs prior weeks)
